changeSet.author: datarun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE feed_ops.pending ( submission_id text NOT NULL, attempts integer NOT NULL, reason text NOT NULL, first_failed_at timestamptz NOT NULL, last_failed_at timestamptz NOT NULL, next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL, dead_at timestamptz, CONSTRAINT pk_feed_ops_pending PRIMARY KEY (submission_id), CONSTRAINT ck_feed_ops_pending_attempts CHECK (attempts >= 1) )
CREATE INDEX idx_feed_ops_pending_due ON feed_ops.pending (next_attempt_at) WHERE dead_at IS NULL
COMMENT ON TABLE feed_ops.pending IS 'Pending changes: submissions whose feed part failed, retried after the live backlog; dead past the attempt cap.'

CREATE TABLE feed_ops.republish ( submission_id text NOT NULL, marked_at timestamptz NOT NULL, attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reason text, last_failed_at timestamptz, next_attempt_at timestamptz, CONSTRAINT pk_feed_ops_republish PRIMARY KEY (submission_id), CONSTRAINT ck_feed_ops_republish_attempts CHECK (attempts >= 0) )
COMMENT ON TABLE feed_ops.republish IS 'Republish marks: submissions whose current records are written again at the same version, kept until written.'
CREATE TABLE feed_ops.normalization_flags ( submission_id text NOT NULL, version bigint NOT NULL, flags jsonb NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_feed_ops_normalization_flags PRIMARY KEY (submission_id) )
COMMENT ON TABLE feed_ops.normalization_flags IS 'The normalizer''s flag counts of each published record that has any, by flag name: server monitoring.'
